/**
   * Returns an input stream for reading a message out from the
   * local message store (.msgStore).
   * That means any message in a local folder, or a message marked as
   * Offline on a non-local folder.
   * The stream contains the single message.
   * The returned stream should _not_ be considered seekable.
   *
   * The reason to use this function instead of calling
   * .msgStore.getMsgInputStream() directly is that IMAP has
   * a gmail-specific hack which allows messages to appear in multiple
   * folders while only storing a single copy locally.
   * nsImapMailFolder overrides this method to handle that case.
   *
   * @param aHdr hdr of message to get the input stream for.
   * @returns an input stream to read the message from
   */
  nsIInputStream getMsgInputStream(in nsIMsgDBHdr aHdr);
